front: What are the parts of an eval?

back: Whether a run passed. Every eval has one, and it can be wrong in its own way.
It can pass a claim it never checked. A judge that reads the reply and not the file rubber-stamps it.
front: How can a model grader fail?

back: It only checks what it was written to check. It cannot tell a true done from a claim the checks never test.
front: What is the code grader's weak point?

back: A regression eval. A capability eval asks what the agent can do yet.
front: Which kind of eval guards a fix you already shipped?

back: The record of each reply and tool result in a run. It is where you see why a grader passed or failed a run.
